player_prompt.intro:
Udla {color} kwi-game ya Breakthrough. Udla {direction} kweni {board_size}x{board_size} board.
Kweni isondo lakho, ukhetha ukhamba inqwelo elilodwa elihambe ngaphezulu noma ngokusemaphandleni ngaphezulu.
Inqwelo ingahamba ngokusemaphandleni ukuba inqwelo lenye yephezulu likho, na ingahamba kuphela kweni isikwele esikhoyo ngokusemaphandleni.
Ngesondo lakho lokuhamba kwi-sikwele nesiqu lenye, udonde na isiqu lenye yephezulu lidlulwe ngokufuduselwa kwenza kwi-board.
Sebenzisa UCI-like notation kwi-brackets, njenge-[a2a3] ukudla a2 ukuya kwa a3.
* 'a' inalingana nekoloni yasekhohlo, '1' ni ilayi ephakathi (kutshanje kwa White).
* Blacks's ihomo ilayi yiyo ilayi ephakamileyo (ilayi 8 kwi-8x8). White's ihomo ilayi yiyo ilayi ephakathi (ilayi 1 kwi-8x8).
Udla wokuqala ophezulu inqwelo lakhe kufike kwi-ihomo ilayi lenye yephezulu, udla. Ukuba inqwelo zakho zonke zadondwa, udla.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nceda usebenzise uphawu lwe-algebra oluphakathi kwezakhelo ezifana no [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: That move does not follow the Breakthrough rules or is not your piece.

outcome.black_reached: Umbala omnyama ufikelele kumqolo wesigxina kaMhlophe.
